_meta.title: Sweden: hate crime reports by police region
_meta.measures: For each of Sweden's seven police regions: police reports flagged as possible hate crimes (2020/2022/2024), how many Brå judged to contain a hate motive, the count and share by motive group (xenophobic/racist, against religious groups, anti-LGBTQI, unspecified) and by individual motive (afrophobic, antiziganist, anti-Sami, antisemitic, islamophobic, christianophobic, homophobic, transphobic...), with Brå's rates per 100,000 residents. 'Hela landet' (whole country) kept as a feature without geometry.
